Following up on Invoice Q-2026-091 for Quantari Systems (due 2026-12-25). Our billing run shows the card authorization was declined and we haven't received a remittance advice yet. We know year-end processes are tight — two quick options to keep this moving: 

1) Split payment: wire 70% now to the bank details attached, and try the card for the remaining 30% after your AP team revalidates the card.
2) Full wire: send the entire balance to the bank details in the attached wire stub.

Separately, our finance team flagged that we need a VAT invoice/PO reference from your side to clear VAT treatment in the EU. I've attached a short VAT evidence request PDF (one page) — if you can return that with the remittance it will speed reconciliation.

Can you confirm which route works by end of day Thursday (2026-12-31)? If preferred, I can loop in our finance partner to accept a formal remittance/confirmation over DocuSign.

Attachments: Q-2026-091-invoice.pdf, quantari_vat_evidence_request.pdf

Thanks — appreciate your help closing this before year-end.

Best,
